IGUI_KnoxPass_OpenTip: Works if the owner shares this gate with your faction or safehouse; otherwise you need a Knox Pass tag registered to this reader, with charge left, in your inventory.
IGUI_KnoxPass_NeedFramework: The management window needs a newer Minidoracat UI framework (MinidoracatUIFor42).
IGUI_KnoxPass_NoPower: No power (needs grid power or a generator)
IGUI_KnoxPass_LockUnsupported: This gate does not support the Knox Pass lock
IGUI_KnoxPass_ConfirmUnregister: Unregister the selected vehicles (%1)? To let them open the gate again, drive them within 15 tiles of the gate and register them again.
IGUI_KnoxPass_ConfirmRemove: Remove this reader? All registered vehicles will be cleared and the reader goes back to your inventory.
IGUI_KnoxPass_RetryHint: Retries automatically within 3 tiles of the gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_NoTags: No vehicles registered yet. Check vehicles under Nearby, then press Register.
IGUI_KnoxPass_NoNearby: No unregistered vehicles with a Knox Pass tag within 15 tiles.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_InVehicle: Get out of the vehicle first.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Unverified: Your identity could not be verified (split-screen players 2-4 cannot manage readers).
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_TooFar: Stand within 3 tiles of the gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Safehouse: You can't do that in someone else's safehouse.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_AlreadyInstalled: This gate already has a Knox Pass reader.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotOwner: Only the reader's owner, a co-manager or a server admin can do that. Ask one of them.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_VehicleTooFar: The vehicle must be within 15 tiles of the gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoTag: This vehicle has no Knox Pass tag installed.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotRegistered: This vehicle's tag is not registered at this gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_TooMany: This reader can register up to 64 vehicles. Unregister vehicles you no longer use first.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoLockSupport: This gate does not support the Knox Pass lock.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoSpeedSupport: This gate's opening speed cannot be changed.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotAllowed: This gate isn't shared with your faction or safehouse, and you have no registered Knox Pass tag with charge left.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Busy: The gate failed to move just now; try again in a moment.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotLoaded: The gate area is not loaded. Move closer to the gate and try again.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_RateLimited: Too many requests; wait a few seconds.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Error: Knox Pass could not complete that action. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the server admin.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_BuiltIn: This reader is built into the barrier; dismantle the barrier's cabinet instead.
IGUI_KnoxPass_AheadWarn: The Knox Pass gate ahead won't open for this vehicle: %1
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoPaint: You don't have paint in that color.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotCarried: The item must be in your inventory (remove an installed tag with the mechanics panel first).
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_BarrierColor: The barrier's built-in reader can't be repainted.
IGUI_KnoxPass_RangeHint: Circle = range when stopped. Faster cars open sooner.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Barrier2_6: Knox Pass Double Boom Barrier (6 wide)
IGUI_KnoxPass_Barrier2_9: Knox Pass Double Boom Barrier (9 wide)
IGUI_KnoxPass_Roll2F_Industry3: Two-Story Roll-up Garage Door (Industrial White, 3 wide)
IGUI_KnoxPass_Roll2F_Industry4: Two-Story Roll-up Garage Door (Industrial White, 4 wide)
IGUI_KnoxPass_Roll2F_Industry6: Two-Story Roll-up Garage Door (Industrial White, 6 wide)
IGUI_KnoxPass_Roll2F_Industry9: Two-Story Roll-up Garage Door (Industrial White, 9 wide)
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersNote: Co-managers can open the management window, change settings, register vehicles and lock the gate. They can't remove the reader or change this list.
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersFactionNone: Faction members (the owner is not in a faction)
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersFactionHint: People who join later count too; leaving the faction ends it
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersReadOnly: Only the reader's owner or a server admin can change this list.
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersNeedFramework: Player search needs a newer Minidoracat UI framework (MinidoracatUIFor42).
IGUI_KnoxPass_LockSafehouseOnly: This server only allows locking gates in the owner's safehouse
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_OwnerOnly: Only the reader's owner or a server admin can do that.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_UnknownPlayer: This server doesn't know a player with that account name (exact name, case-sensitive). Pick from the suggestions below the box, or wait until they have been online once.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_TooManyManagers: A gate can have up to 8 co-managers. Remove one first.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoFaction: The reader's owner is not in a faction.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_InstallSafehouseOnly: On this server you can only install readers in your own safehouse.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_LockSafehouseOnly: On this server only gates in the owner's safehouse can be locked.
